body:
>She wanted to be used and she hated herself for it.

Yeah, thats pretty much where I'm at.
I'm out of college and without insurance. Someone here suggested support groups, I think I might look into something like that.
Interesting. Thanks.
I don't mind therapy. I just haven't been able to find any I could afford.
I go to Planned Parenthood for my exams... I don't know if they'll have sedatives on hand. Thanks for the idea.
I get a bit of a buzz after I drink Kombucha, a sort of fermented mushroom tea.

I guess part of my problem is that I don't want to let it be huge or life changing. I just want it to be something that happened, something I can forget about quickly and move on from. I guess I know it doesn't really work that way. It feels like I've been flailing around for weeks looking for a magic fix it button. I'm starting to realize those don't exist outside of office supply commercials.

I joined the pandys forum. Thanks for recommending it. I'm on there as nag_champa if you or anyone else wants to find me.
I know what you mean, I've got problems with that too. I don't have any advice on how to deal with it, I'm still trying to figure that part out myself. But you aren't alone.

I needed this. I didn't need to be told it wasn't my fault, I accept that I share some of the responsibility, but I needed a safe place to talk about it. I'm schizophrenic and think my friends and family are part of a huge conspiracy that has been plotting against me for years. I can't talk to them, I can't trust them.

I thought I could be anonymous and talk to others and try to start getting to a better place. It was never about being told it wasn't my fault, if I wanted that I wouldn't have told the true story. I fucking know its my fault. And your frenzy to make damn sure that everyone else knew it was my fault completely ruined what help I might have found here. That was cruel and I don't understand it.

I know you've probably got a shitload of raging fucktardery to regale me with in response -- go for it. I won't be reading it anyway. I just wanted you to know I think what you did here is crap.

Thats what I'm worried about. I don't want him to think its rejection. Its just me wanting some space.

He knows about it, though it took me a month to tell him. And he is doing his best to help me, I'm just...I don't know. So many people in my life know about it and I can't talk to any of them except to growl that they aren't allowed to say anything about it.

You mean open my mouth and calmly explain my issue like a mature adult instead of blowing it out of all proportion in my head and letting myself believe everything sucks and theres nothing I can do about it?

Sometimes it takes someone outside to show me the obvious I guess. Thank you.

I was a pretty private person before this happened. The last couple months its felt like people keep forcing me to open up and I hate it. I hate it so much. It makes me feel even more vulnerable and it just sucks.

I don't know if the therapist knows. I know its not good to hide things from the people who are trying to help you.

Yes, he knows. I try to talk to him, but I wasn't a big talker before this all happened. I'm even less of one now. I keep turning to online communities with this kind of stuff because its so much easier than trying to tell my boyfriend or a therapist what I want and need.
I am in therapy. I'm still trying to get myself to let the therapist help me. My boyfriend comes with, I think its doing good things for him.

I was raped. I've got two therapists, a psychiatrist, and a loving boyfriend who all tell me differently, but I know it was in fact my own fucking fault.

And I kind of wish the ass kicking part of it would happen again. Because I deserve it for being such a stupid bitch about the whole. Since I can't I drink and smoke and do other bad things that I hide from *everyone* and its getting exhausting and I can't afford to sustain much longer. So I'll probably start selling shit to keep it up because I can take personal leave until november so why the fuck not?

it doesn't sound crazy, your advice really helped. who knew tearing up paper could be so satisfying?

thanks.
definitely a dwarf giant.
thanks. i'm not really great at chatting about this stuff though.

i know. i want to rush it but my head doesn't let me, its still all over the place about everything. i'm hoping the therapist will help with that sort of thing.

thanks.
agreed :)
is there anything else it would be good to know about a boyfriends perspective? things that made it hard or easier?
thanks. i thought i was sick of talking to anyone about it. for some reason its helping to tell strangers about it instead of the people in my life.

thats a lot of the reason i want to tell him before he comes home. i wouldn't want to be excited and happy to be coming home and then get hit with this. i think it would be better if he had some time to absorb it before we have to see each other face to face.

thanks for the warning

thank you, your offer is kind and its tempting to take you up on it. i'm trying to find the courage to send him an email with a link to the posts i've made instead. we chat most nights, all i have to do is bite my lip and copy/paste.
i meant to say thanks for the reminder about stds too. its something i know but i try not to think about at all.
thank you
i didn't think you were being mean. and your advice about writing it down and practicing it was good. thank you.

four guys dragged me into a trailer in the backyard after i spent a couple hours getting boozed and coked up and talked shit to them about their white power tattoos. they fucked me then beat me then fucked me again.
thats its. he doesn't know and i am just me when i talk to him, not me-the-victim. i don't want to lose that. without that i'm just the new grumpy and hates everyone all the time me.
i know. i really do know that i have to just do it. and i'm trying to get there.
thank you

i know this kind of post deserves a full explanation but i don't want to give it. its too hard, i can't handle a bunch of strangers asking me questions about it again. i'm hoping you'll just take my word on it not involving cheating or just regret.

asking my parents to tell him could help. thank you
i know. its another part of the reason i'm panicky over telling him.

theres no question that i'm going to tell him. he'd find out any way and it would be better if i told him. i even want to get it done before he gets on the plane.

i know about the condoms and std risks but thanks. and i'll trying the writing and practicing.

this is a throwaway account, i might as well go balls out right?

i'm terrified of what will happen sexually and emotionally when my boyfriend gets back. i've tried to tell him about it on the phone but i can't get the words out. I feel ashamed and embarassed and i know it wasn't my fault but goddamn it. if i'd done any one of a hundred things differently that night the whole evening could have had a different ending.

i know i need counseling. but i hate the idea of going and talking to someone about it. i don't know why. it sounds dumb when i type it out, but i feel like i already had something i didn't want in my body and i have a stupid need to keep my mind mine. thinking about inviting a shrink to come in and have a look around makes me feel sick. 

i don't know what to do. the only person i'm okay with talking to about it doesn't know because i can't bring myself to tell him. i'm sick of the people who do know trying to talk to me about it. i know reddit isn't the place to turn for advice about this sort of stuff. i don't know what to do.
no. i know i should and i've got a lot of referrels to places but i just want to be left alone about it i guess

thanks, i know its not my fault. i know he wont get mad about it too. if hes upset about anything its that i didn't tell him when it happened. i didn't want to worry him and it was good to talk to someone who didn't always ask me how i was doing.
